params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of comments to retrieve

items.docs:
Returns a list of [Comment](https://gtidocs.virustotal.com/reference/comments) objects.  
Check comments done in VT Community regarding a specific URL.

- `data`: list of ("comment" objects)[ref:comment-object].

info.name: VirusTotal Add a Comment on a URL

items.docs:
> 📘 See [URL identifiers](https://gtidocs.virustotal.com/reference/urls#url-identifiers) from more information about how to generate a valid URL identifier for a URL.

With this endpoint you can post a comment for a given URL. The body for the POST request must be the JSON representation of a comment object. Notice however that you don't need to provide an ID for the object, as they are automatically generated for new comments.

Any word starting with # in your comment's text will be considered

info.name: VirusTotal Get Object Descriptors Related to a URL

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of related objects to retrieve

items.docs: This endpoint is the same as [/urls/{id}/{relationship}](https://gtidocs.virustotal.com/reference/relationships) except it returns just the related object's IDs (and context attributes, if any) instead of returning all attributes.

info.name: VirusTotal Add a Vote on a URL

items.docs:
> 📘 See [URL identifiers](https://gtidocs.virustotal.com/reference/urls#url-identifiers) from more information about how to generate a valid URL identifier for a URL.

With this endpoint you can post a vote for a given URL. The body for the `POST` request must be the JSON representation of a vote object. Notice however that you don't need to provide an ID for the object, as they are automatically generated for new votes.

The verdict attribute must have be either `harmless` or `malicious`.

info.name: VirusTotal Get Objects Related to a URL

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of related objects to retrieve

items.docs:
> 📘 See [URL identifiers](https://gtidocs.virustotal.com/reference/urls#url-identifiers) from more information about how to generate a valid URL identifier for a URL.

URL objects have number of relationships to other URLs and objects. As mentioned in the [Relationships](https://gtidocs.virustotal.com/reference/relationships) section, those related objects can be retrieved by sending `GET` requests to the relationship URL.
